2608.10605.title: Compute-Optimal Is Not Cluster-Optimal: Systems-Aware Scaling for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
2608.10605.paper_summary: In large-scale pretraining, the algorithm, architecture, and systems decisions are conventionally made in disconnected stages. A scaling law stage selects an architecture and training recipe, optimizing loss under compute constraints, and a separate systems stage then optimizes the implementation for hardware efficiency. In this work, we develop MOSAIC, which formulates model architecture and systems co-design as an optimization problem. MOSAIC couples a predictive scaling law with a calibrated performance model that estimates Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU), communication cost, memory footprint, and the best parallel layout. We instantiate the framework for sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models, where expert count, routing sparsity, and other MoE layer dimensions affect both the loss and systems efficiency. We fit a scaling law on sparse MoE models trained on text data, whose scaling dimensions include the sparsity factor, which is the fraction of model parameters inactive per token in a forward pass. The scaling law sweeps in our work span active parameters from $104$ million to $2.7$ billion and total model sizes reaching $79$ billion parameters. We show that, within the calibrated sparsity range, an efficiency-agnostic model-FLOPs budget admits no interior optimal sparsity. The fitted loss decreases monotonically with sparser models and the compute optimum lies at the upper boundary of the data support. An optimal sparsity in MoE models instead emerges under the cluster's systems constraints, as captured by MOSAIC. Our results argue for a shift towards unified architecture and systems co-design for frontier language model training.
2608.10605.paper_summary_zh: 在大規模預訓練中，算法、架構和系統的決策通常是在不連貫的階段中進行的。擴展法則階段選擇一個架構和訓練配方，在計算約束下優化損失，然後一個單獨的系統階段再優化硬體效率的實現。在這項工作中，我們開發了MOSAIC，它將模型架構和系統共同設計表述為一個優化問題。MOSAIC將預測性擴展法則與一個經過校準的性能模型結合在一起，該模型估算模型FLOPs利用率（MFU）、通信成本、內存佔用和最佳並行佈局。我們為稀疏的專家混合模型（MoE）語言模型實現了該框架，其中專家數量、路由稀疏性和其他MoE層維度影響損失和系統效率。我們在基於文本數據訓練的稀疏MoE模型上擬合了一個擴展法則，其擴展維度包括稀疏因子，即在前向傳播中每個標記不活躍的模型參數的比例。擴展法則在我們的工作中掃描的活躍參數範圍從$104$百萬到$2.7$十億，總模型大小達到$79$十億參數。我們顯示，在經過校準的稀疏範圍內，一個與效率無關的模型-FLOPs預算不允許內部最佳稀疏性。擬合的損失隨著模型的稀疏性單調減少，計算最佳點位於數據支持的上邊界。相反，在MoE模型中，最佳稀疏性是在集群的系統約束下出現的，這一點由MOSAIC捕捉到。我們的結果主張應該轉向統一的架構和系統共同設計，以進行前沿語言模型的訓練。
